requirements.text: Goals contain name, unit, total, deadline, color, optional obstacle and coping plan.
Multiple check-ins per goal per real date are supported with collision-safe IDs.
All mutations hydrate then persist through namespaced AsyncStorage; seed appears only for empty storage.
Today's suggestion is remaining amount divided by remaining calendar days and is prefilled but editable.
Completion rate and forecast use recorded amounts; forecast requires enough real samples and compares against deadline.
Monday-Sunday streak grants exactly one rest miss per week; a second miss breaks it; creation boundary and backfill dates are respected.
Yesterday's first miss is yellow and second miss is red/rolled into today; overdue days are correct.
Today has top and bottom create actions, actionable goal cards, edit, confirmed delete, check-in and adjust-plan exits.
Check-in supports editable amount, optional minutes and backfill for the previous six days.
Cards show progress, streak, forecast/deadline status and obstacle/coping plan.
Each goal has a progress ring, three core metrics, plan and ten latest removable records.
Fourteen-day per-goal stacked minutes chart is inline SVG and excludes records without minutes.
Monday-Sunday weekly amount, check-in days and minutes compare with prior week on the same basis without mixing units.
Historical weeks are navigable; four reflection fields save immediately.
Generated report text includes comparisons and all four reflection fields.
JSON export, prevalidated overwrite-confirmed import and legacy migration work, including valid empty backups.
Clear examples and exact-phrase clear-all are distinct and confirmed as requested.
Three-step add-to-home-screen guidance is present.
Three labeled examples and records visibly exercise backfill, rest-day, consecutive misses and contingency plans.
At 20 records the backup banner appears and its CTA directly produces export data.
Cold white/purple/success/danger/amber system, coherent hierarchy and no starter residue.
All production icons/charts are local inline SVG; no emoji, glyph icons or external icon package.
Goal completion triggers an actual running confetti animation.
Phone bottom tabs/single column, tablet top navigation and desktop fixed side navigation/multi-column are implemented.
Typecheck, source audit, Harmony Go export, artifact integrity and exact-app launch pass.
At least one core product mutation changes an exact UI value and remains after force-stop/reopen.
